name: Dynamic Data Search
author: iflairwebtechnologies

sections.description:
Dynamic Data Search is a powerful, lightweight, and fully customizable search enhancement plugin for WordPress.
Search results appear instantly while typing — no page reload, no lag.

Supports posts, pages, custom post types, categories, taxonomies, WooCommerce products, and even Gutenberg Templates (FSE) — making it the most flexible universal search tool.

✨ Features

  • 🔍 Instant AJAX Data Search
  • 🎯 Keyword highlighting with <mark>
  • 📄 Custom Search Results Template (Grid/List)
  • 🛍 WooCommerce Product Search (title + short description)
  • 🧱 Gutenberg Template Search (wp_template + wp_template_part)
  • 🗂 Search across all public post types & taxonomies
  • 📌 Load More button (AJAX)
  • 🎨 Full design customization:
    • Font color
    • Button color, text color, hover color
    • Result grid background
  • 🧩 Shortcode: [ddsp_data_search]
  • 🛡 Clean code following WP security & sanitization standards
  • ⚡ Loads only one CSS + one JS file for optimal performance

🧠 Gutenberg Template Search (New)

Enable template search to include contents from:

  • Site Editor → Templates
  • Template Parts

This is extremely useful for FSE themes where real site content is built in templates rather than pages.

🔧 Shortcode

Add the data search box anywhere:

🚀 Installation

  1. Upload plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/dynamic-data-search/
  2. Activate plugin from Plugins menu
  3. Go to Settings → Dynamic Data Search
  4. Configure:
    • Post types
    • Taxonomies
    • Layout (Grid/List)
    • Design colors
    • Gutenberg template search
  5. Place the shortcode or visit / ?s=keyword

📌 Screenshots

  1. Search bar with data AJAX dropdown
  2. Plugin Settings Page
  3. Custom Search Results (Grid)
  4. Custom Search Results (List)
  5. Gutenberg Templates appearing in search results

📦 Changelog

1.1.0

  • Added Gutenberg template search
  • Added button hover text color
  • Improved admin settings UI
  • Added Overview improvements
  • General performance enhancement

1.0.1

  • Initial release.

Arbitrary Section

Dynamic Data Search focuses on simplicity, speed, and flexibility.
Built for developers and users who want fast, accurate, customizable search.
